summary: This class discusses whether it is permissible to eat nuts on Rosh Hashanah, examining the origins of the custom not to eat walnuts and the reasons behind it. It reviews the sources in Shulchan Aruch, Maharil, and Chida, and explains the Sephardic community practice regarding eating nuts.
questions: Can we eat nuts on Rosh Hashanah?
Where does the custom not to eat walnuts come from?
Does eating walnuts cause extra mucus or coughing during shofar blowing?
What is the numerical value of 'egoz' compared to 'chet'?
Do Sephardic communities have a custom of not eating walnuts on Rosh Hashanah?
